Subject: CS platform vendor shortlist & next steps

Team,

After the scoping sessions last week I've pulled together a lightweight shortlist for CS tooling to replace/augment our current stitched setup. Top candidates: Zendesk (for ticketing + advanced routing), Intercom (messaging + product touchpoints) and Gainsight (health & playbooks). I put a comparison sheet in the linked Drive (vendor_pricing_matrix.xlsx) with the rough feature gaps we care about (SLA telemetry, customer history across models, native playbooks, integration surface with our billing API).

Key asks from this thread:
- Can each vendor confirm an enterprise demo (technical + procurement) by EOD Friday?
- Mina: please flag any missing security evidence early (SOC2, data flows, KMS/HSM support).
- Karthik: preliminary ask to validate budget/contract cadence (12 vs 24 months) and whether we should consolidate two vendors vs go point-solution + best-of-breed.
- Marissa/Steph: help set up a 45-min product fit demo and a 30-min CS ops session to validate migration lift.

I will loop in vendor reps in the next message. I want to keep momentum—ideally a shortlist decision and vendor pricing by Aug 18 so we can get procurement started.

Thanks,
Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships & Procurement, Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: vendor responses & recommended path (short summary)

Fwding vendor replies into thread for visibility. Summary / recommended path:
- Zendesk: strong on ticketing and telemetry; good enterprise SLAs; likely best for high-volume triage but more engineering lift for model-aware routing. 12mo discount ~15%.
- Intercom: best for in-product messaging and early triage; lower migration cost for product events; pricing ballpark higher unless we negotiate a bundle.
- Gainsight: strong for playbooks & health scoring; recommend as complementary to either Zendesk or Intercom rather than a replacement for ticketing.

Recommendation (short): run a two-vendor approach for pilot: Intercom for product messaging + automated triage, and Zendesk for ticketed escalations. Gainsight can be evaluated as a health/playbooks pilot with CS team in Q4.

Action items:
1) Karthik — please check procurement budget and preference for 12 vs 24 month commit. If budget is tight we can pursue consolidated 24-month discount with Zendesk/Gainsight bundle.
2) Mina — schedule a short sync with each vendor's compliance lead; I flagged Priya (Zendesk) and Ben's security resource for Intercom.
3) Marissa/Stephanie — schedule the product demos listed by vendors next week and confirm attendee list.

I'll set up calendar invites after we confirm timings.

Thanks,
Vanessa
